description: This file implements a Windows-specific address sorter for network endpoints, utilizing Windows socket APIs and asynchronous task execution.

classes.name: AddressSorterWin
classes.description: Windows-specific implementation of AddressSorter that sorts network addresses asynchronously.

classes.name: AddressSorterWin::Job
classes.description: Helper class performing asynchronous address sorting using Windows SIO_ADDRESS_LIST_SORT ioctl.

methods.name: AddressSorterWin::Sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of IPEndPoints asynchronously using Windows socket IOCTL.

methods.name: AddressSorterWin::Job::Start
methods.description: Static method to initiate the address sorting job asynchronously.

methods.name: AddressSorterWin::Job::Run
methods.description: Performs the address list sorting ioctl call in a background thread.

methods.name: AddressSorterWin::Job::OnComplete
methods.description: Callback executed after sorting completes, processes sorted addresses.
